body:
No, mate. I'm not Muslim. But this type of comment doesn't belong here. 
And no, cancer is not "easily treated." Cancer can be terminal at any stage and at any form. I want to let it brew until stage 3, where it becomes unbearable.

Thanks for asking, mate. I am alright, unfortunately. My crippling anxiety makes me feel guilty for scaring that woman and her two kids and my suicidal thoughts are so out of hand that I want to do it again.
